messages.subject: unloading packages
parts:
I want to unload some packages in the middle of my R program.

I am using
  unload(inst("XLconnect"))
  unload(inst("XLconnectJars"))
  unload(inst("Rjava"))

this works very well on my local machine. But the deployed shiny app crashes with this.

I have also tried using:

  unload("/usr/local/lib/R/site-library/XLconnect")
  unload("/usr/local/lib/R/site-library/XLconnectJars")
  unload("/usr/local/lib/R/site-library/Rjava")

But the shinyapp log says that these files cannot be found in this folder.

Any suggestions. In which folder within the shinyapp.io are the libraries loaded, so that I can specify the path properly?


Thanks,
Anirban

messages.subject: Re: unloading packages
parts:
Are you certain that nothing after the unload might be attempting to use XLConnect?
Also, by any chance are you running locally on Windows? shinyapps.io runs Linux, and the unload documentation leads me to believe that if there are shared libraries involved, unload may fail.
